subject: Graduate Site Engineer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Goldsmith team,

I'm applying for the Graduate Site Engineer role on your Melbourne projects, advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, doing site inspections and quality checks, tracking materials and writing progress reports. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your list of first duties, from ITPs and hold point inspections to daily site diaries and look-ahead schedules, is the site work I want to grow in. I haven't used GPS set-out equipment on a job yet, so the training you mention matters to me.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Goldsmith Civil and Environmental has delivered civil, mechanical and electrical work across South Eastern Australia since 1954, including earthworks, waterways, wastewater, landfill and civil and road projects.
letter.subject: Application for Graduate Site Engineer, Melbourne
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Site Engineer role on your project sites in and around Melbourne, advertised on SEEK. I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and travelling between sites suits me.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. That course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and progress records, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

The first duties in your advert, from QA documentation and hold point inspections to daily site diaries, claims and look-ahead schedules, are the parts of site engineering I want to build on. My site work so far was overseas and I have not used GPS set-out equipment on a job, so the training you offer is a big reason I am applying. I hold a White Card and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
